_about: Defaults every deck builds with: the answers file's format, the master deck's slug, and the standard Questions to Ask themes. build_deck.py reads it; a deck adds its own themes in meta.deck.askThemes.

askThemes.title: Role History
askThemes.testing: Why the seat is open, and who held it before.

askThemes.title: Team and Reporting
askThemes.testing: Where the seat sits, and where it's headed.

askThemes.title: Scope
askThemes.testing: What the role owns, and what it doesn't.

askThemes.title: Stability and Runway
askThemes.testing: Whether the company can fund the plan.

askThemes.title: The First Year
askThemes.testing: What the job is, day to day.

askThemes.title: Leadership and Culture
askThemes.testing: How the people above this seat lead.

askThemes.title: Before You Leave
askThemes.testing: Their doubts, and the next step.
